settings.heading: Made for you, not for a warehouse.
settings.text: We don't make shirts and hope someone buys them. We wait for you. Then one maker cuts, stitches and finishes your shirt by hand.

settings.title: Fabric
settings.text: Your length of linen, poplin or silk is set aside only when you order.

settings.title: Pattern
settings.text: We draft from your size, or your own measurements.

settings.title: Cut
settings.text: Cut by hand, one shirt at a time. No stacks, no waste.

settings.title: Stitch
settings.text: One maker sews your shirt from collar to hem.

settings.title: Finish
settings.text: Pressed, checked, wrapped, and signed with a handwritten card.

settings.title: Less waste
settings.text: Nothing is made that isn't wanted.

settings.title: A better fit
settings.text: Cut to your size or your body.

settings.title: Never mass-produced
settings.text: Each piece passes through one pair of hands.

settings.heading: Slower, on purpose.
settings.text: Waiting a week is the price of a shirt that was made for you alone.
